patch_description:
This crossover keeps the strongest observed component from the current program: the K=2.5 edge-count sizing heuristic, which scored best among the supplied variants. It simplifies and accelerates the zero-noise GED branch: instead of constructing all canonical graphs and expensive all-pairs GED tables, it directly gathers distinct non-isomorphic graph representatives and performs exact permutation-aware matching only when required. For positive noise it retains the edge-count code, using evenly spaced edge totals and direct nearest-expected-count decoding.

This removes unnecessary canonical-cache construction and pairwise precomputation while preserving the required interactive protocol and exact decoding behavior for epsilon=0.
